description: The plot titled “ChatGPT on Movies” illustrates how three metrics (Accuracy, Confidence, and Alignment) vary with Question Popularity. The x-axis is labeled “Question Popularity,” uses a linear scale, and spans roughly from 15 to 55 with tick labels shown at regular 5-unit intervals (15, 20, 25, 30, 35, 40, 45, 50, 55). The y-axis is labeled “Values,” uses a linear scale, and ranges from 0.86 to 1.00 with labeled ticks at 0.86, 0.88, 0.90, 0.92, 0.96, 0.98, and 1.00. The Accuracy series is shown as a blue solid line with circular markers, starting near 0.895 at popularity 15, rising to about 0.921 at 16, dipping to about 0.901 at 17, then increasing through about 0.933 at 19 and about 0.962 at 21, reaching about 0.960 at 24, about 0.965 at 27, about 0.972 at 31, about 0.981 at 38, and ending around 0.986 at 55. The Confidence series is shown as a green solid line with upward triangle markers, beginning around 0.977 at 15, staying near 0.978–0.979 at 16–17, increasing to about 0.988 at 20, then to about 0.990–0.992 across the low-to-mid 20s, reaching about 0.995 at 31, remaining around 0.994 at 38, and ending near 0.997 at 55. The Alignment series is shown as a red solid line with square markers, starting around 0.919 at 15, rising to about 0.941 at 16, dropping to about 0.921 at 17, increasing to about 0.943 at 19 and about 0.972 at 21, dipping slightly to about 0.969 at 24, then increasing to about 0.973 at 27, about 0.976 at 31, about 0.987 at 38, and ending around 0.990 at 55.
